preconditions.description: Input a must be a string.
Input b must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output string length is the sum of the lengths of input strings a and b.

postconditions.expression: stdout[:len(a)] == ''.join(c.swapcase() if c.lower() in b.lower() else c for c in a)
postconditions.description: The first part of the output string is the modified version of a with swapped cases based on characters in b.

postconditions.expression: stdout[len(a):] == ''.join(c.swapcase() if c.lower() in a.lower() else c for c in b)
postconditions.description: The second part of the output string is the modified version of b with swapped cases based on characters in a.
